name: Open setup and inspect the database SQL
covers: Supabase setup workflow
database schema instructions
SQL copy instructions
description: Verifies a first-time user can open setup and view the database SQL without entering credentials.
steps: Open SquadChat
Select Setup
Select View database SQL
expected: The setup dialog displays the SQL schema and a copy SQL action, and no credentials are required just to inspect it.

name: Validate account registration inputs
covers: registration username validation
password length validation
mobile responsive layout
description: Verifies the registration form requires a valid username and a password of at least eight characters.
steps: Open SquadChat
Choose Create account
Enter an invalid username or a password shorter than eight characters
Submit the form
expected: The browser blocks invalid required fields or the app shows a validation message, and no account is created.

name: Show recent activity in conversation list
covers: conversation list latest-message preview
conversation list activity timestamp
unread message count badges
read receipts on sent messages
online presence and last seen status
green online indicator in direct conversation list rows
mobile chat-list styling
messages remain stored
cross-device message updates without browser refresh
description: Verifies conversations display recent activity and new messages from another device appear automatically without refreshing the browser.
steps: Sign in with a test account that has an existing conversation
Open the conversation list
Actor A sends a message from Device A while Actor B is viewing the conversation list on Device B
Wait for the latest-message preview and unread badge to update on Device B without refreshing
Actor B opens the conversation and verifies the newest message is visible immediately at the bottom of the message list, even when older unread messages exist
expected: While Actor B is viewing the conversation list, Actor A's new message updates the conversation preview and unread badge without refreshing. When Actor B opens that conversation, the newest message is visible at the bottom without first positioning the viewport on an older unread message. The unread divider remains available in the message history, and the unread count clears. Messages show Sent or Read when a participant has read them, and the conversation row shows recent activity and the online indicator when applicable.

name: Require configuration before real messaging
covers: configuration required state
honest backend readiness messaging
no simulated messages
description: Verifies the app shows that Supabase setup is required when no project credentials have been configured.
steps: Open SquadChat in a fresh browser context without saved configuration
Observe the connection status
Open the setup dialog and cancel it
expected: The app shows Setup required and never displays fake conversations or claims that real messaging is connected.

name: Edit and save profile details including a device photo
covers: clean profile editor
display name and bio validation
profile changes saved to Supabase
select anime avatar
upload profile photo from device
profile photo persists and appears in chat list
description: Verifies a signed-in user can edit their display name and bio while username and email remain read-only.
steps: Sign in with a configured test account
Open Profile
Enter a display name and short bio
Select Save profile
Open the profile editor again
expected: The updated display name, bio, and selected anime avatar remain visible after reopening the editor, while username and email remain unchanged.

name: Render image attachments and keep chat within mobile viewport
covers: open image attachments in an in-app viewer and close with back navigation
long image URLs do not overflow mobile viewport
photo message preview shows sender-aware friendly text
mobile chat responsive layout
description: Verifies image attachment messages are rendered as inline images when loaded from stored messages and long URLs cannot expand the phone layout horizontally.
steps: Sign in with a test account that has a conversation containing an image attachment
Open the conversation and inspect the latest image message
Return to the conversation list and reopen the same conversation
Check that the image remains an image and the page fits the phone width
expected: The stored image message is rendered inline rather than as a raw storage URL; the conversation list shows Photo sent for the current user's image and Sent a photo for another participant's image, without horizontal page overflow.

name: Delete own message with confirmation
covers: long-press message action menu with emoji reactions
delete own message appears first in the vertical action menu
vertical Delete, Reply, Pin action order with borderless buttons
action menu closes when tapping outside
destructive-action confirmation
database delete policy
realtime message removal
message history updates after deletion
description: Verifies a signed-in user can delete their own message after confirmation and the message disappears from the conversation.
steps: Sign in with a configured test account and open an existing conversation
Send a new text message named Delete Me
Press and hold the sent message to open the compact vertical Delete, Reply, Pin action menu
Select Delete from the menu
Confirm the deletion
Check that the message is no longer visible and remains absent after reopening the conversation
expected: The app asks for confirmation, deletes only the signed-in user's message, and the removed message does not return after reopening the conversation. Other participants' messages remain visible.

name: Reply to incoming and outgoing messages with a right swipe
covers: swipe right on an incoming message to quote-reply
swipe right on own outgoing message to quote-reply
touch swipe gesture works in Android WebView
reply preview identifies the selected message
description: Verifies a user can swipe right on either participant's message and the composer targets the exact selected message.
steps: Sign in on a mobile device and open a conversation with both incoming and outgoing messages
Swipe right on an incoming message and verify the reply composer identifies that message
Cancel the reply, then swipe right on one of the user's own outgoing messages
Verify the reply composer identifies the outgoing message and send a reply
Verify the sent message displays a quote preview for the selected outgoing message
expected: A rightward swipe on either an incoming or outgoing message opens the reply composer for that exact message; sending the reply shows the correct quoted message and sender.

name: React to a message and remove own reaction
covers: add emoji reaction
reaction count updates
remove own reaction
reaction sync across participants
reaction persistence after reopening conversation
description: Verifies conversation members can react to a message, see reaction counts, remove their own reaction, and retain reactions after reopening the conversation.
steps: Sign in with Actor A and open an existing conversation
Press and hold a message to open its emoji reaction menu
Verify the thumbs-up count appears
Sign in as Actor B on another device and verify the reaction appears
Actor A selects the same reaction again to remove it
Reopen the conversation and verify the reaction remains removed
expected: The reaction count is visible to both actors in real time, and Actor A can toggle their own reaction off without affecting other reactions or messages.

name: Show a clear error for an unavailable Supabase project
covers: Supabase connection error handling
user-visible error state
mobile setup
description: Verifies a malformed or unreachable Supabase configuration results in a visible setup or connection error rather than a false success.
steps: Open Setup
Enter a syntactically valid project URL and an invalid publishable key
Save and connect
expected: The app displays a connection or authentication error and does not claim that messages are being delivered.

name: Prevent duplicate direct chats on rapid taps
covers: direct-message request lock
disabled Message button while opening
loading spinner and opening feedback
reuse existing direct conversation
prevent duplicate conversations on double-click
description: Verifies rapid taps on Message are ignored while a direct conversation is being opened or created.
steps: Sign in with a configured test account and search for a registered friend without an existing direct chat
Tap Message twice quickly
Observe the Message button while the request is pending
Wait for the conversation to open
Return to the conversation list and search for the same friend again
Tap Message again
expected: The first tap immediately changes the button to a disabled Opening chat state with a spinner; the second tap does not create another request. Exactly one direct conversation exists, and tapping Message later reopens that same conversation.

name: Keep conversation avatars stable during list refreshes
covers: conversation avatar image node reuse
no profile picture flicker during conversation list rerenders
avatar updates when profile photo URL changes
description: Verifies conversation list refreshes preserve existing avatar image elements and only replace them when the underlying photo URL changes.
steps: Sign in with an account that has a conversation with a friend who has a profile photo
Trigger a conversation list refresh by opening and closing a conversation or receiving a new message
Observe the friend's avatar while the list updates
Change the friend's profile photo and refresh the conversation list
expected: The existing profile photo stays visible without repeatedly flashing or reloading during list updates; a genuinely changed photo URL replaces the old image.

name: Reset password link opens password form
covers: Supabase password recovery callback
new password and confirmation validation
recovery session does not auto-open chat
successful password update and return to login
description: Verifies an email recovery link routes to a new-password form instead of automatically entering the chat app.
steps: Request a password reset for a test account
Open the reset email link in the same browser
Enter a new password and matching confirmation
Save the new password
expected: The app shows the Choose a new password form, rejects mismatched passwords, updates the password, signs out of the recovery session, and returns to login with a success message.

name: Prevent duplicate group chats
covers: group creation double-submit protection
reuse existing group with same name and members
group creation success and error feedback
description: Verifies repeated group creation attempts do not create a second conversation when the same group name and member set already exist.
steps: Sign in with a configured test account and at least two registered friends
Create a group with a name and those two friends
Submit the same group name and member list again
Check the conversation list and opened conversation
expected: The create button is disabled while the request is processing; a repeated matching request opens the existing group instead of creating a second conversation, and visible feedback explains the result.

name: Reset password with the emailed one-time code
covers: email OTP recovery verification
single active password reset form
password update after OTP verification
return to login after successful reset
password recovery does not initialize chat or query conversation membership
description: Verifies the email-code reset flow keeps one form active while Supabase emits its recovery event and saves the new password.
steps: Request a password reset for a test account
Enter the newest emailed recovery code and a matching new password
Submit the reset form
Observe the result and return to login
expected: The OTP form remains in control during verification, no second recovery form replaces it, the password update completes, no conversation list or membership query is triggered by the USER_UPDATED event, and the user returns to login with a success notice.

name: Receive and clear in-app message notifications
covers: message-triggered notification creation
recipient-only notification visibility
unread notification badge
mark notification read
open the related conversation from a notification
realtime notification delivery between accounts
description: Verifies a message sent by one member creates a private in-app notification for the other member and that the recipient can clear and open it.
steps: Sign in as Actor B on Device B and leave SquadChat on the conversation list
Sign in as Actor A on Device A and send a message in their shared conversation
Wait for Actor B to receive the new notification without refreshing
Open the notification bell and select the new-message notification
Return to the notification list and mark any remaining notifications as read
expected: Actor B sees an unread badge and a notification naming Actor A; selecting it opens the correct conversation and marks it read. Actor A does not receive a notification for their own message.

name: Reconnect live chat after returning from background
covers: reconnect active conversation realtime channel on app resume
suppress background-only realtime interruption notice
new messages sync after app resume
description: Verifies the active conversation restores live updates after the mobile app is backgrounded and reopened.
steps: Sign in on a mobile device and open an existing conversation
Send the app to the background without closing it
Send a new message from Actor B on another device
Return to SquadChat on the first device
Wait for the conversation to reconnect
expected: SquadChat refreshes the active conversation and restores its live subscription; the new message appears without a manual app restart, and a background-only connection interruption does not produce a misleading error notice.

name: Open the Basic Admin dashboard and manage account status
covers: admin-only dashboard access
dashboard account and conversation statistics
user search by username or display name
suspend and reactivate accounts
admin account cannot suspend itself
ordinary users cannot access admin controls
description: Verifies the configured admin can view dashboard statistics and user controls while regular users do not see admin entry points.
steps: Sign in as the configured admin account
Open the Admin dashboard from the profile panel
Verify the statistics and user list appear
Search for a test account by username
Suspend the test account and verify its status changes
Reactivate the same test account and verify its status returns to Active
Sign in as an ordinary account and inspect the profile panel
expected: The admin sees the dashboard and can suspend/reactivate a test account. The admin cannot suspend their own account. An ordinary user has no Admin dashboard button and cannot call admin actions.

name: Show ADMIN badges and confirm permanent deletion with Cancel or Delete
covers: ADMIN badge in own profile
ADMIN badge in friend profile
ADMIN badge in direct conversation list
ADMIN badge in group member list
account deletion removes related messages and files
permanent account deletion confirmation with Cancel and Delete buttons
account deletion removes related messages and files
creator-owned conversations are reassigned or removed before account deletion
deleted-account direct conversations remain visible as unavailable
deleted-account direct conversations block opening messaging, replies, reactions, and attachments
description: Verifies the admin identity is visible to all members and account deletion uses a clear Cancel/Delete confirmation without requiring typed text.
steps: Sign in as an ordinary account that has a direct chat with the admin
Verify ADMIN badge beside the admin in the conversation list and profile
Open a group containing the admin and inspect Group settings member list
Sign in as admin and open Admin dashboard
Choose Delete for a disposable test account and click Cancel
Verify the account remains in the user list
Choose Delete again and click the Delete button
Verify the account is removed and can no longer sign in
Sign back in as the remaining participant who had a direct chat with the deleted account
Verify the old direct conversation is labeled User not available
Open the unavailable conversation and verify the composer and attachment controls are disabled
expected: The ADMIN badge appears in relevant profile and member views. Cancel leaves the test account unchanged. Confirming Delete permanently removes the disposable account and its related content; any conversations it created are safely reassigned to remaining members or removed if empty. A remaining direct conversation whose other account was deleted is labeled User not available, and messaging, replies, reactions, and attachments are disabled.

name: Lock suspended accounts to logout and block direct messages
covers: suspended account logout-only screen
account status polling
reactivation notice
direct messages blocked for suspended recipient
no push notification to suspended recipient
description: Verifies suspended members see only the logout action, cannot use app navigation, receive a reactivation notice after access is restored, and are excluded from direct-message delivery.
steps: Actor A suspends Actor B from the Admin dashboard
Actor B's open SquadChat session updates to the account-suspended screen
Verify Chats, Friends, Profile, search, and messaging controls are unavailable and Log out is the only action
Actor A attempts to send a direct message to Actor B
Verify the direct message is rejected and Actor B receives no new-message notification
Actor A reactivates Actor B
Actor B signs in again
expected: Actor B is limited to the suspension screen and logout. Direct messages to the suspended account are blocked and no push notification is delivered. After reactivation, Actor B can sign in and sees a suspension-lifted notice before normal SquadChat access resumes.

name: Confirm signup email without logging into the browser
covers: signup email confirmation callback
no browser login session from signup confirmation
manual return to SquadChat login
description: Verifies a signup confirmation link displays success, removes one-time URL tokens, and asks the user to return to the app and log in manually.
steps: Open a valid SquadChat signup confirmation link in the browser
Verify the standalone email-confirmation page appears
Verify no login form or chat controls are visible behind the notice
Return to the SquadChat app manually and log in
expected: The browser shows only the email-verified notice and instructions to return to the app manually. No login form, continue button, or chat screen is displayed.

name: Return to conversation list after every login
covers: successful login opens conversation list
clear previously selected conversation
Chats navigation selected after login
description: Verifies logging in always starts at the conversation list rather than reopening a previous chat or another mobile section.
steps: Sign in and open an existing conversation
Log out
Sign in again with the same account
Observe the initial screen
expected: The conversation list is visible, the Chats navigation item is selected, no conversation is selected, and the previous chat is not reopened.

name: Do not show a suspension lock when status verification temporarily fails
covers: account status check error handling
temporary network failure does not create false suspension
active session remains usable during status-check outage
description: Verifies a temporary account-status endpoint failure does not falsely block an account whose suspension has not been confirmed.
steps: Sign in to an active test account
Temporarily make the account-status check unavailable while keeping the authenticated session active
Observe the app screen
expected: SquadChat does not display the suspended-account lock for a verification error; only an explicit suspended status can activate that lock.

name: Show sender profile photos and open at the latest message
covers: gallery-uploaded profile photo beside incoming messages
anime avatar fallback beside incoming messages
no ME avatar beside own messages
group sender display names
open conversation at latest message even when older unread messages exist
description: Verifies incoming message rows use the sender's saved gallery photo or anime avatar, own messages have no ME avatar, and conversation history opens at the newest message without briefly showing older messages first.
steps: Actor A uploads a profile photo from the device gallery and sends a message to Actor B
Actor B opens the private conversation and checks the sender avatar
Actor B sends a reply and checks that no ME avatar appears beside the outgoing message
Actor A sends two more messages while Actor B is away
Actor B opens the conversation and verifies the latest message is the first visible bottom position, without a brief jump from older unread messages
Open a group conversation and inspect the sender name and avatar for incoming messages
expected: Actor A's uploaded profile photo appears beside incoming messages, outgoing messages have no ME avatar, group messages identify their sender, and every conversation opens directly at the latest message. Older unread messages and the New messages divider remain in the history above it.

name: Resume an active conversation without rebuilding its message list
covers: conversation visibility resume
preserve existing message DOM and scroll position
sync new messages after returning from background
no duplicate messages after reconnect
description: Verifies returning to SquadChat after the app was backgrounded reconnects live updates without clearing and rebuilding the open conversation.
steps: Sign in as Actor B and open a conversation
Scroll to a position above the latest message
Send a new message to Actor B from Actor A while SquadChat is in the background
Return to SquadChat
Observe the existing message history and the new incoming message
expected: The existing message history remains in place, the new message appears once, the previous scroll position is preserved when the user was not near the bottom, and no duplicate messages are displayed.

name: Keep the New messages divider without moving the initial viewport
covers: first unread incoming message divider placement
latest-message initial viewport
no unread divider when all messages are read
description: Verifies the unread divider remains attached to the first unread message while the conversation initially opens at the latest message.
steps: Actor A sends several messages while Actor B is away
Actor B opens the conversation
Verify the New messages divider appears immediately before the first unread incoming message in the history above the latest message
Mark all messages as read and reopen the conversation
expected: The conversation opens at the latest message, while the New messages divider remains immediately before the first unread incoming message farther up the history. After all messages are read, the divider is absent and the conversation still opens at the latest message.

name: Keep short message text on a natural single line
covers: natural message bubble width
short text does not wrap vertically
long text wraps without horizontal overflow
description: Verifies short messages use compact bubble widths while long messages wrap within the phone viewport.
steps: Open a conversation on a 375px-wide mobile viewport
Send a short message such as hahaha
Send a long unbroken message and a multi-line message
Observe the bubbles and page width
expected: The short message remains on one line in a compact bubble; long text wraps within the message area and no horizontal page overflow appears.

name: Reply to chatmate messages and show live typing status
covers: swipe right to reply to incoming messages
no reply toolbar above composer
composer expands by one line and returns to one line
typing indicator uses a shared conversation topic across devices
conversation preview and ordering update immediately after a new message
description: Verifies incoming-message replies, compact composer sizing and cross-device typing status.
steps: Actor A and Actor B sign in on separate mobile devices and open the same private conversation
Actor A sends a message; Actor B swipes that incoming message to the right and sends a reply
Verify the reply displays the quoted message and no reply preview bar appears above the composer
Actor B types multiple lines and clears the text; verify the composer grows by only one line and returns to normal height
Actor A starts typing and Actor B observes Typing.. at the lower-left above the composer
Actor A sends another message while Actor B is viewing a different conversation or the conversation list
Actor B returns to the conversation list and checks the preview, timestamp and conversation order
expected: Incoming messages can be swiped right to reply; the sent reply contains its quoted message without a composer toolbar. The composer grows to at most two lines and shrinks when cleared. The other participant sees Typing.. at the lower-left above the composer while typing and the label disappears when typing stops. Both devices share the same conversation typing channel. A newly sent or received message immediately updates its conversation preview and moves that conversation to the top of the list without waiting for a periodic refresh.

name: Synchronize shared chat background between members
covers: circular improvements button beside PRIVATE and GROUP labels
shared solid color, gradient, and uploaded image backgrounds
background updates synchronized between two members
background persistence and reset
conversation-specific background isolation
description: Verifies either conversation member can change the shared background and both devices show the saved choice.
steps: Actor A and Actor B open the same private conversation on separate devices
Actor A taps the circular exclamation button beside PRIVATE and selects Change chat background
Actor A selects a gradient and Actor B observes the update without reopening the chat
Actor B selects a solid color and Actor A observes the update
Actor A uploads a supported background image and Actor B observes it
Actor B reopens the conversation and selects Reset to default
Actor A verifies the default background returns and another conversation remains unchanged
expected: The compact button sits beside PRIVATE or GROUP; both members can select solid, gradient, and uploaded image backgrounds; updates synchronize live; settings persist after reopening; reset restores the default; and other conversations are unaffected.

name: Browse shared photos and download original images
covers: shared photos scoped to the active conversation
newest-first image order
sender and timestamp metadata
full-screen photo navigation
download original image
deleted message photos removed from gallery
description: Verifies conversation members can browse shared images and download an original file without modifying the message attachment.
steps: Actor A and Actor B open the same private conversation
Actor A sends two photos and Actor B sends one photo
Actor B opens the exclamation menu beside PRIVATE and selects Shared photos
Verify the three photos appear newest first with sender and time
Open a photo, navigate to another, and tap the download icon
Verify the downloaded original is in device Downloads and the chat attachment remains
Delete one original photo message and reopen the gallery
expected: The gallery shows only photos from that conversation, newest first, with sender and time; the viewer supports navigation and downloading the original file; downloads do not change chat messages; and deleted messages no longer appear in the gallery.

name: Confirm image download and require an APK update for older Android versions
covers: successful native image download notice above the picture
legacy Android APK update notice above the picture
modern animated in-viewer download feedback
browser download fallback remains available
description: Verifies the latest Android APK confirms a successful Gallery save and older Android WebView builds receive a clear download instruction instead of a misleading download result.
steps: Sign in on an Android device using the latest SquadChat APK and open a conversation with a shared photo
Open the photo viewer and tap Download
Verify a modern success notice appears above the picture inside the viewer and says the image was downloaded to Pictures/SquadChat
Open the same web app in an older SquadChat APK without the native save bridge
Tap Download on a shared photo
expected: The latest APK shows 'Downloaded! Saved to Pictures/SquadChat.' only after Android confirms the save. An older Android APK shows an update notice asking the user to install the latest SquadChat app before downloading to Gallery. Non-APK browsers retain their normal browser download or share behavior.

name: Select and send multiple photos from the Android in-app gallery
covers: Android WebView file chooser opens the custom bottom-sheet gallery
numbered multi-photo selection in the in-app gallery
selected content URIs become WebView image files without Base64 batch transfer
oversized photos are compressed below the upload limit
selected photo previews stay inside the message composer
send selected photos together in one message
description: Verifies the Android gallery selection returns multiple image files to the web composer and the selected images can be uploaded together.
steps: Install the latest SquadChat APK on an Android device and sign in with a configured test account
Open an existing conversation and tap Photo
Verify SquadChat's own bottom-sheet gallery appears instead of the Android Files app
Select at least three photos and verify each receives a selection number
Tap Send photos in the gallery and verify all selected images appear as composer thumbnails
Tap Send in the composer and verify one message containing all selected photos appears in the conversation
expected: The APK opens SquadChat's custom gallery, returns the selected content URIs through the WebView file chooser, displays all selected images in the composer, and sends them together as one image-set message without a large Base64 bridge payload.

name: Display multi-photo messages as a compact selectable album stack
covers: multiple photos render as one overlapping stack instead of a large grid
album preview shows total photo count
tapping the album opens every photo in the viewer
viewer thumbnails allow direct selection of any photo
single-photo messages retain their existing inline image behavior
description: Verifies a multi-photo message uses a compact overlapping stack and opens a viewer where every photo can be selected directly.
steps: Actor A sends four photos together in one message
Actor B opens the conversation and verifies the message uses one compact overlapping stack with a four-photo count
Actor B taps the stack and verifies the first photo opens in the full-screen viewer
Actor B taps the fourth thumbnail and verifies the fourth photo appears
Actor A sends one photo separately and verifies it remains a normal single-photo message
expected: The four-photo message occupies one compact stacked preview, the count is visible, tapping opens the full album, thumbnail selection opens the chosen photo, and a separately sent single photo keeps its normal display.

name: Open saved conversations and queue messages while offline
covers: service worker caches the SquadChat app shell after an online visit
previously loaded conversations and latest 200 messages are available offline
offline text messages persist in IndexedDB and display a waiting status
offline photo selections persist as one queued album
identical queued photo albums are consolidated before syncing
recently sent identical photo albums are protected from rapid repeat sends
a different photo album can still be queued while offline
queued photo albums immediately show local image previews with a waiting status
queued messages sync after connectivity returns without duplicate message rows
queued sends recheck account suspension, peer status, and conversation membership
description: Verifies a signed-in user can reopen previously cached chats offline, queue text and photo messages, and sync them only after server access is restored.
steps: Sign in while connected and open a conversation containing messages and photos so the app shell and chat history are cached
Disconnect the device from Wi-Fi and mobile data
Reopen SquadChat and verify the saved conversation and previously loaded messages are visible
Send a text message and select multiple photos, then queue the album
Select the same photos again before reconnecting and verify the app reports that the album is already queued without adding another copy
Select two different photos while still offline and verify they are saved as a separate second album with local previews
Before reconnecting, verify both queued albums are visible immediately in the chat with their images and Waiting for connection status
Reconnect the device and wait for the queued items to sync
Verify the text message appears once and the photos appear together in one album message
expected: Previously loaded chats and messages remain visible offline. Text and selected photos are stored locally with a waiting status; each different album appears as its own local preview and syncs after connectivity returns. Duplicate queued albums are consolidated, and a recently sent identical album cannot be accidentally sent repeatedly during the protection window. The account, peer status, and conversation membership checks still apply.

name: Retry offline photo uploads without overwriting existing files
covers: offline photo retry skips files already uploaded
retry does not require storage object update permission
album message is saved after all photo URLs are confirmed
one queued album produces one durable message after reconnecting
description: Verifies a retry after a partial upload reuses existing stored photos and completes the album message without attempting an unauthorized object overwrite.
steps: Sign in with a configured test account and open a conversation
Queue a multi-photo album while offline
Reconnect after some or all photo objects have already reached storage but the album message has not been saved
Allow the queue to retry
Open the same conversation from Actor B's account
expected: The retry confirms existing photo objects instead of overwriting them, uploads only missing files, saves one album message, and Actor B can see the complete album.

name: Show connection status notices across every screen
covers: connected notice after login and session restore
internet-lost notice appears while viewing or typing in a conversation
connection-restored notice after network returns
connection notices float above the active screen without entering chat history
connection notice does not interrupt the message composer
description: Verifies connection feedback is app-wide, transient, and separate from conversation messages.
steps: Sign in while the device has an internet connection and verify a connected notice appears
Open a conversation and focus the message composer
Turn off Wi-Fi and mobile data
Verify an internet-lost notice appears over the conversation while the composer remains usable
Turn connectivity back on
Verify a connection-restored notice appears and no connection notice was added to the conversation history
expected: The user sees a connected notice after login, an internet-lost notice over the current screen when connectivity drops, and a restored notice when connectivity returns. Notices remain separate from chat messages and do not block typing.

name: Show cached conversations before background refresh completes
covers: cache-first conversation list
background Supabase refresh
preserve saved conversation list during network delay
description: Verifies a previously cached conversation list is rendered immediately while the server refresh continues.
steps: Sign in with an account that has a previously loaded conversation list
Return to SquadChat after leaving it in the background
Observe the conversation list before the network refresh completes
expected: Previously cached conversations are visible without waiting for the full server query, then their latest previews and unread counts update when fresh data arrives.

name: Open a push-notification conversation before the full chat list loads
covers: direct notification conversation lookup
membership-authorized notification navigation
notification target retained during session restoration
description: Verifies a notification can open its target conversation even when the in-memory chat list has not finished loading.
steps: Sign in on an Android device with an existing conversation
Leave SquadChat in the background and receive a message notification
Tap the notification while the conversation list is not yet populated
expected: The app resolves the requested conversation through the signed-in user's membership, opens that conversation directly, displays cached messages when available, and clears only that conversation's notification after opening.

name: Resume an active conversation without duplicate messages
covers: preserve active conversation on app resume
cache-first message display
duplicate message prevention
resume realtime synchronization
description: Verifies returning to SquadChat keeps the active conversation visible and merges new messages without duplicating cached rows.
steps: Open an existing conversation and load its recent messages
Leave SquadChat in the background while another participant sends messages
Return to SquadChat using the app icon
expected: The same conversation remains open, saved messages remain visible during refresh, new messages appear once, and realtime synchronization resumes without a full blank-screen reload.

name: Inspect admin metrics, account filters and activity history
covers: admin-only dashboard access
online and registration statistics
filter accounts by active or suspended status
filter accounts by admin or member role
account registration and last-seen details
admin audit activity history
description: Verifies the administrator can review current metrics, filter account records, and inspect recorded account actions without exposing the dashboard to regular users.
steps: Sign in using the existing administrator account
Open the Admin dashboard from the profile panel
Verify the dashboard displays online users and new registrations today and this week
Filter the account list to suspended accounts, then to administrators
Verify account rows include registration and last-seen information
Open Admin activity and inspect the latest account actions
expected: Only the administrator can open the dashboard. The dashboard shows the additional metrics, status and role filters return matching accounts, account rows show registration and last-seen dates, and the activity section displays the latest recorded admin actions.

name: Open admin account details
covers: admin user details view
account registration and last-seen information
message and conversation activity counts
recent account action history
admin-only account detail access
description: Verifies an administrator can open a member's detail panel and review account facts, activity counts and recent account actions.
steps: Sign in using the existing administrator account
Open the Admin dashboard
Select View details on a listed account
Review the account status, joined date, last seen, message count and group counts
Close the account details panel
expected: The account detail panel displays the selected user's profile and activity information, then closes without changing the account or dashboard state.

name: Show group membership activity and reaction previews
covers: group activity message when members are added
group activity message when a member is removed
group activity message when a member leaves
latest reaction preview in private conversations
latest reaction preview in group conversations
existing chat and reaction behavior remains available
description: Verifies group membership changes appear as simple conversation activity messages and reactions to the signed-in user's messages update the conversation preview in both chat types.
steps: Sign in as a group administrator and add another account to a group
Open the group conversation and verify an activity message identifies the added member
Remove a different member and verify the removal activity message appears
Have a group member leave and verify the departure activity message appears for remaining members
In a private chat, have the other participant react to a message sent by the signed-in user
Repeat the reaction test in a group chat
expected: The group timeline shows who was added, removed, or left. The private and group conversation list previews show 'Reacted [emoji] to your message' when another participant reacts to the signed-in user's message, while ordinary messages and reaction chips continue to work.
